_readme: This is the knowledge base for the site's chat assistant. Add or edit entries here — each has keywords to match against a visitor's question, and an answer the bot will give. No sensitive personal data belongs here (no ID numbers, family details, addresses, or anything not meant to be public — this file is publicly readable by anyone who views the site's source).

identity.answer: I'm Zeenan's assistant! Haa Meem Ul Karim Zeenan (goes by Zeenan) is a Digital Marketing Expert & Consultant, NSDA Level 3 certified, working with clients across Europe, America, and Asia.

services.answer: Zeenan offers SEO (search engine optimization), content strategy & writing, keyword research, and social media marketing. Want to book a consultation? I can take you to the appointment form.

certifications.answer: Zeenan holds an NSDA (National Skills Development Authority, Bangladesh Government) Level 3 certification in Digital Marketing for Freelancing, plus a Professional Digital Marketing certificate (Grade A+) from Creative IT Institute. Check the Certifications section for the full details.

location.answer: Zeenan is based in Bangladesh and works with clients across Europe, America, and Asia — fully remote, so location isn't a barrier.

contact.answer: You can reach Zeenan by email at haameemulkarim.zeenan.dm@gmail.com, on WhatsApp, or through the appointment form on this site — I can take you there now if you'd like.

appointment.answer: You can apply for an appointment right on this site — I'll scroll you to the form. Just fill in your name, WhatsApp number, email, purpose, and goal, and Zeenan will get back to you within 1-2 business days.

pricing.answer: Pricing depends on the scope of work — every project is a little different. The best way to get an accurate quote is to book a quick consultation through the appointment form so Zeenan can understand what you need.

seo_general.answer: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the practice of improving a website so it ranks higher in search results and gets found by the right people. There's a whole blog on this site with practical SEO guides if you want to dig deeper!

keyword_research.answer: Keyword research means figuring out exactly what your potential customers type into Google, so your content targets real search demand instead of guesswork. Check the Projects section for a sample of what this looks like in practice.

blog.answer: There's a full blog on this site covering SEO, keyword research, and digital marketing tips — great if you want to learn the fundamentals yourself. Want me to take you there?

worldwide.answer: Yes — Zeenan works with clients across Europe, America, and Asia, not just Bangladesh. All work is done remotely, so distance isn't an issue.

response_time.answer: Zeenan typically responds within 1-2 business days after you submit the appointment form.
